column2: St. Rylan followed Statera, goddess of balance, potters and vigilance against evil.
Statera's worship has long declined; she is no longer in the official Imperial Pantheon.
A great shadow has covered the Forest of Dawn since ancient times, once held off by human and animal sacrifice.
The temple's faithful made the shadow dormant, at least while the temple was active.
Archmage Hann of the Imperial Court visited the temple 33 years ago on his own business, and sealed the Thing in the Tavern.
The Empire's decline began around then too; nobody knows which came first.",1,seven-silver-spheres,,Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes
